run_mode.description: Operational mode: 'daemon' for standalone service, 'inetd' for inetd/xinetd supervision.

listen_port.description: The TCP port ident2 listens on. Default is 113 (auth).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed in daemon mode. Set to null to use system default.

client_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for client connections.

random_replies.description: If true, always send random replies regardless of client request type.

allow_noident.description: If true, check for ~/.noident file to disable replies for specific users.

user_ident_enabled.description: If true, allow users to define custom replies in ~/.ident.

user_reply_file.description: Path to the file ident2 reads for user-defined replies.

skip_uid_change.description: If true, ident2 will not drop root privileges.
